text: Requesting amendments to parking regulations on Gulliver Road between Keele Street and Comay Road.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the north side of Gulliver Road, between Keele Street and a point 30.5 metres east of a point opposite there easterly limit of Comay Road. 2. Prohibited parking from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Monday to Friday, on the north side of Gulliver Road, between a point 76.3 metres west of a point opposite the westerly limit of Comay Road and Culford Road.
